G1_host_communication_survey.summary: Verified loopback-only networking. No existing tunnels (cloudflared, tailscale, caddy, nginx, etc.) installed or running. Single minimal route recommended.

G2_isolated_poc_lane_procedure.summary: Documented in RUN_BRIDGE_LOCAL.md. Specified lane 'poc-fastpath-007', bind '127.0.0.1:18888', dedicated state dir, env-based secrets.

G3_sites_minimal_connection_contract.summary: Drafted SITE_PROMPT_LIVE.txt with 5 MCP operations, server-side secret management, private access, explicit live/mock labeling, and BLOCKED state when unconfigured.

G4_boundary_hardening_and_running_concur.summary: Fixed thread_resume error handling and synchronous initialization check in LaneDriver::spawn. Hardened tests/concurrency_pause.rs to verify status and pause during actual Running phase.

G5_operator_steps_minimization.summary: Local daemon and Site prompt are fully prepared. External connection remains safely bounded to loopback until operator approves/provides TLS tunnel and creates Site.

AC-02.description: Deterministic transition cycle and durable event persistence

AC-03.description: Bounded HTTP gateway and safe IPC socket permissions
AC-03.evidence: 401 on unauthorized, header/body size limits, 0700/0600 socket permissions verified.

AC-04.description: Non-blocking runtime concurrency and pause during worker execution
AC-04.evidence: tests/concurrency_pause.rs verifies status and pause during Running phase.

AC-06.reason: Out-of-band turn interrupt requires app-server turn/interrupt RPC channel. Explicitly returns NOT_SUPPORTED per critical source findings.
